column1: # Game globals read or written by decompiled code, US and PAL addresses ([decomp] globals of game.toml). Read and
# checked in both DOLs by tools/decomp_globals.py, run by tools/build.py, which writes the identifier header
# (decomp_globals.h, enum class global_id) and the address array of the version being built; decompiled code names a
# global by its identifier (gc::global<T, global_id::...>, runtime/core/decomp/gc_mem.h), never by its address.
# Format (TSV, columns by name; full description and checks in the header of tools/decomp_globals.py):
#   id  name  us_addr  pal_addr  size  section  kind  used_by  status  evidence
# id: C++ identifier, or "-" for a row only documented and checked (a constant is written as a literal in the code).
# name: CodeWarrior-style symbol for a C++ runtime object (__vt__ = virtual table, __RTTI__ = type descriptor),
#   otherwise descriptive (f32_const_<function> = float constant in .sdata2 read by that function).
# kind: data, const, vtable, callback. used_by: functions of decomp/functions.tsv, or GGTE01 addresses of functions
#   known to the symbol sources. status: verified (role cross-checked in both versions) or hypothesis (name or role).
# First rows: reverse agent (mission D1 no. 6, 2026-10-27); format of mission D2-2 (2026-10-29).
# This file only contains names, addresses and sizes, no game data (no value is copied here).
# This file is dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0 (see /LICENSES/CC0-1.0.txt).
